pairs.es: What ending does any -AR, -ER, or -IR verb take in the yo form?
What is the difference between -ER and -IR verb endings?
pairs.en: Only nosotros and vosotros differ: -ER uses -emos/-éis; -IR uses -imos/-ís. All other forms are identical.

pairs.es: To conjugate a regular verb, what do you do to the infinitive?
pairs.en: Drop the -ar / -er / -ir ending from the infinitive, then add the correct ending for the subject pronoun.

How do you know whether a verb is -AR, -ER, or -IR?
pairs.en: Look at the last two letters of the infinitive (the dictionary form): hablar → -AR, comer → -ER, vivir → -IR.
